newsitem.title: FINLAND: NESTE BUYS REST OF RESINS UNIT IN MEXICO.
newsitem.headline: NESTE BUYS REST OF RESINS UNIT IN MEXICO.

text.p: Finnish state-controlled oil, energy and chemicals group Neste Oy said in a statement on Friday it had bought the remaining 11 percent stake of its own subsidiary Neste Resinas S.A. de C.V. in Mexico.
Neste bought the shares from Finnfund.
In 1990, Neste and Finnfund each bought 50 percent of Mexican Quimicas Priha Guadians S.A. de C.V.>, which later became Neste Resinas.
The acquisition of the rest of the company supported Neste's strategy of becoming "the world's leading supplier of adhesives for the forest industry," Neste said.
The Mexican company's annual output capacity is 20,000 tonnes of adhesive resins and 12,000 tonnes of formaldehyde, it said.
Neste's total annual output capacity of adhesive resins is 1.44 million tonnes.
